title: Book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Book cover shadow/base -->
  <rect x='14' y='20' width='72' height='60' rx='4' fill='#1a4a6e'/>
  <!-- Book pages - left side -->
  <rect x='18' y='24' width='32' height='52' rx='2' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <!-- Book pages - right side -->
  <rect x='50' y='24' width='32' height='52' rx='2' fill='#f0dfb8'/>
  <!-- Page lines on left -->
  <line x1='24' y1='34' x2='44' y2='34' stroke='#d4c4a0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='24' y1='42' x2='42' y2='42' stroke='#d4c4a0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='24' y1='50' x2='44' y2='50' stroke='#d4c4a0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='24' y1='58' x2='40' y2='58' stroke='#d4c4a0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='24' y1='66' x2='44' y2='66' stroke='#d4c4a0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Page lines on right -->
  <line x1='56' y1='34' x2='76' y2='34' stroke='#d4c4a0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='42' x2='74' y2='42' stroke='#d4c4a0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='50' x2='76' y2='50' stroke='#d4c4a0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='58' x2='72' y2='58' stroke='#d4c4a0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='66' x2='76' y2='66' stroke='#d4c4a0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Spine -->
  <rect x='46' y='22' width='8' height='56' rx='2' fill='#2a6d9e'/>
  <!-- Spine highlight -->
  <rect x='48' y='24' width='3' height='52' rx='1' fill='#4a9ed6'/>
  <!-- Book cover edges top and bottom -->
  <rect x='14' y='18' width='72' height='6' rx='3' fill='#2a6d9e'/>
  <rect x='14' y='76' width='72' height='6' rx='3' fill='#2a6d9e'/>
  <!-- Cover edge highlights -->
  <rect x='16' y='19' width='68' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#4a9ed6'/>
  <rect x='16' y='77' width='68' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#4a9ed6'/>
  <!-- Cute bookmark ribbon -->
  <rect x='60' y='14' width='6' height='20' rx='1' fill='#e63946'/>
  <polygon points='60,34 63,38 66,34' fill='#e63946'/>
  <rect x='61' y='14' width='2' height='18' rx='0.5' fill='#ff6b7a'/>
  <!-- Small star decoration on cover -->
  <polygon points='33,88 35,82 37,88 31,84 39,84' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- Little heart on the page -->
  <path d='M62,30 C62,27 65,26 66,29 C67,26 70,27 70,30 C70,33 66,36 66,36 C66,36 62,33 62,30 Z' fill='#ff6b7a'/>
</svg>
